_noteQ: Q (Broken Wings) re-verified via wiki: 'Riven can activate Broken Wings three times... dealing physical damage to enemies hit' each time, and the wiki's own 'Total Physical Damage' line (135/225/315/405/495) is EXACTLY 3x the single-cast 'Physical Damage' line (45/75/105/135/165), confirming all 3 casts deal IDENTICAL damage. riven.bin.json's RivenQ spell defines only ONE damage calc, 'FirstSlashDamage' (BaseDamage DataValue + ADRatio(mStat=2,mStatFormula=2=bonus AD)) -- no SecondSlashDamage/ThirdSlashDamage calc exists anywhere in the file, confirming the game engine reuses the same calc for all 3 real casts rather than defining distinct ones. _noteR: R (Blade of the Exile / Wind Slash): MinDamage (MinBase DataValue + 0.6xBonusAD, matches wiki's floor '100/150/200 (+60% bonus AD)') was already correctly curated and is kept as the honest floor. riven.bin.json also defines MaxDamage (MaxBase + 1.8xBonusAD, matches wiki's ceiling '300/450/600 (+180% bonus AD)') but NO calc or DataValue anywhere in the file expresses the '0% - 200% increase based on target's missing health' interpolation between Min and Max that produces the real in-game number -- grepped for any Missing-HP-named DataValue/calc, none exists; the blend is computed by native engine code outside any GameCalculation this project's FormulaInterpreter can read, and the stat resolver has no defender-missing-HP stat either.
